fixturePolicy: Synthetic records use example.invalid values; they contain no tenant credentials or live customer data.

hubspot.requiredScopes: Object-specific CRM read scopes are required. This metadata does not claim a complete token scope set; validate the private-app token in tenant preflight.
hubspot.rateLimitSource: The adapter honors Retry-After when returned. Per-endpoint rate-limit headers/quotas were not specified in the official references reviewed.

estimateActivities.required: object-specific readable properties and hs_timestamp lower-bound filter

listActivities.required: object-specific readable properties and hs_timestamp range filters
listActivities.pagination: after cursor; maximum requested page size 200

getActivity.required: explicit activity ID and object-specific readable properties

getAssociations.pagination: after cursor; up to 100 source IDs per adapter call

getContacts.pagination: adapter batches at most 100 IDs per request

getCompanies.pagination: adapter batches at most 100 IDs per request

getContact.required: contact read access and an exact record ID

getCompany.required: company read access and an exact record ID

updateContact.required: contact write access; fixed allowlisted string properties, maximum 500 characters; explicit empty string permits clear

updateCompany.required: company write access; fixed allowlisted string properties, maximum 500 characters; explicit empty string permits clear

addContactCompanyAssociation.required: contact/company association write access; validated IDs; HubSpot-defined unlabeled contact-to-company type 279
addContactCompanyAssociation.response: Ignore provider body; return validated contactId and companyId. Follow-up read verifies the association.

albi.requiredScopes: Authorization: Bearer <key>; each endpoint needs one Permissions.<Domain>.<Action> scope, and a 403 names the missing one.
albi.rateLimitSource: Per key: 150 requests/minute (sliding), 5,000/hour, 10 in flight by default. A 429 carries Retry-After in seconds (1 = concurrency, 60 = minute window, longer = hourly quota).

verifyCredentials.required: Contacts.View (or Organizations.View); Company.View is optional and only supplies the display name; the key's rows must name exactly one company

listContacts.pagination: limit (max 100) and opaque continuationToken; the adapter maps numbered cursors onto tokens

listOrganizations.pagination: limit (max 100) and opaque continuationToken; the adapter maps numbered cursors onto tokens

createContact.required: Contacts.Create; firstName, lastName, contactTypeIds, referralSourceId; companyId is sent

createOrganization.required: Organizations.Create; name, organizationTypeIds, referralSourceId; companyId is sent

createActivity.required: Activities.Edit; activityTypeId, date, notes, and exactly one of contactId or organizationId
createActivity.sourceFields: source is stored and returned; there is no external id field, so the notes source marker stays the dedupe key.

updateContact.required: Contacts.Edit; partial update of firstName, lastName, email, phoneNumber, jobTitle, organizationId and address fields; blanks are refused

updateOrganization.required: Organizations.Edit; partial update of name, email, phoneNumber and address fields; blanks are refused

listActivities.pagination: limit and opaque continuationToken, newest first
